scenario: The ego vehicle passes straight through an urban T-junction while a pedestrian crosses ahead and an adversarial vehicle turns left into the main road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the T-junction.

adversarials.behavior: The pedestrian crosses the street from the left side of the road ahead of the ego vehicle.
The car executes a left turn from the left arm of the T-junction into the main road.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle travels on the main road approaching a T-junction, with a pedestrian crossing from the left side of the road ahead of the ego, and an red adversarial car positioned on the left arm of the T-junction preparing to turn left into the main road.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distances to the T-junction are defined for the ego vehicle, and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has passed through the intersection.

road_side_structures.position: Surrounding the T-junction on all sides, forming an urban environment.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the centered car traveling straight; pedestrian and red car are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: two adversarials (Pedestrian and Car). 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches T-junction, pedestrian visible on left roadside; midpoint pedestrian crosses street while red car begins left turn; ending ego passes through junction as red car completes turn. 4. Evidence: pedestrian's position shifts from left curb across the lane; red car's orientation changes from facing the junction to aligning with the main road.
